hook: Quoc Le was born in 1982 in Hương Thủy, in Vietnam's Thừa Thiên Huế province, and moved to Australia in 2004 to study at the Australian National University. He moved to the United States in 2007 for graduate study at Stanford University, where he earned a PhD in 2013 under Andrew Ng with a thesis on scalable feature learning. Le was a founding member of Google Brain in 2011, and in 2014 he co-authored the sequence to sequence learning paper with Ilya Sutskever and Oriol Vinyals, as well as an early version of the doc2vec method for learning vector representations of documents. In 2016 he began the AutoML project at Google Brain, which led to Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning, co-authored with Barret Zoph, showing that a neural network could design other neural networks that outperformed hand engineered ones. He later contributed to the Meena and LaMDA conversational models and to research on chain of thought prompting, and continues to work as a Distinguished Scientist at Google DeepMind.
name: Quoc Le

quote.text: I really love machine learning. Teaching machines how to learn is a new way to do computer programming: instead of writing the program, you teach a machine to do it.

quick_facts: Born in 1982 in Hương Thủy, Thừa Thiên Huế province, Vietnam
Earned a PhD from Stanford University in 2013, advised by Andrew Ng
Founding member of Google Brain in 2011
Co-created the sequence to sequence (seq2seq) learning model in 2014
Started the AutoML project and co-created Neural Architecture Search in 2016
Won the NeurIPS Test of Time Award in 2024

achievements.title: Co-created sequence to sequence learning
achievements.impact: With Ilya Sutskever and Oriol Vinyals, showed an encoder decoder LSTM could translate between languages end to end, a technique later generalized across natural language processing.

achievements.title: Developed doc2vec
achievements.impact: Extended word embedding techniques to represent entire documents as vectors, aiding text classification and retrieval.

achievements.title: Co-invented Neural Architecture Search
achievements.impact: With Barret Zoph, used reinforcement learning to have one neural network design another, launching the AutoML line of research that automates model design.

achievements.title: Contributed to chain of thought prompting research
achievements.impact: Helped show that prompting large language models to reason step by step improves their performance on complex tasks.
